text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words, NLP enables machines to grasp the meaning behind them. For example, translation tools use NLP to convert text from one language to another while keeping the original intent. Another common use is sentiment analysis, which determines whether a piece of writing sounds positive, negative, or neutral. This is especially helpful for companies monitoring customer feedback. Additionally, chatbots rely on NLP to hold conversations with users, answering questions and solving problems in real time. As NLP improves, our interactions with technology become more natural and intuitive.
